prompt_translation: Place both hands in a clean elegant crossed-hand arrangement in front of the body, with a clear primary hand and supporting hand rather than ambiguous interlacing.

Each visible hand must have exactly five anatomically coherent digits, natural finger-length hierarchy, believable knuckles and a clear wrist direction; sleeves must not obscure the critical finger-root structure.
principle: Hands are a generation-time structural constraint for asset portraits, not only a post-generation repair item.
